regulator: AGEPAR (Agência Reguladora de Serviços Públicos Delegados do Paraná) — tariff homologation + service-quality monitoring of the Pontal do Sul ↔ Ilha do Mel crossing; SEIL/PR credentials vessels via chamamento público (001/2019 regular; 01/2025 nautical taxi); IAT manages the state park and visitor cap (Lei Estadual 22.315/2025: 5,000/day, up to 11,000 with electronic control); Capitania dos Portos (Brazilian Navy) for vessel safety; Prefeitura de Pontal do Paraná operates the public terminal.
annual_basis_note: Two distinct official series exist and must not be mixed: (1) IAT park visitation (unique visitors entering the conservation unit: 247,020 in 2025) and (2) Abaline boat boardings (383,162 embarked in 2025 — one-way boardings across all origins, including residents and return legs not captured in park counts). The AGEPAR-regulated corridor is Pontal do Sul ↔ Nova Brasília/Encantadas only; Paranaguá services are authorized boats outside the tariff table. FX used: 5.0727 BRL/USD (BCB PTAX 2026-07-15). Economics remain CONDITIONAL per payload: no AGEPAR-published corridor-level passenger series is pinned yet.
confidence: medium-high (2025 visitation and boardings are single-year official/operator figures via reputable press; regulated tariff value last confirmed for 2023)
gaps: No official multi-year AGEPAR/SEIL passenger series published online for the regulated crossing — the new Imply electronic ticketing system (contracted Dec 2025) should produce exact counts; request from AGEPAR/IAT when engaging.
